name: Sakahogi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Sakahogi town emblem in green: a ring with two pointed ears enclosing a stylised leaf.
history: Municipal flag of Sakahogi, a town in Gifu Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 1968.

features.role: Sakahogi town emblem — a ring with two pointed ears enclosing a stylised leaf
